rules: High Perception; high Acrobatics, plus high style skill; high Dex; high AC; low Fortitude, high Reflex; moderate HP; moderate attack and low to moderate damage before precise strike plus high or extreme damage with precise strike. Abilities: Confident finisher, panache, precise strike, stylish combatant, swashbuckler's style (plus exemplary finisher at 9th level)
